name: Penthe Thoughtwalker
body:
You are experienced in traveling to and through dreamscapes.

Prerequisite(s): Dreamspeaker racial trait, character level 11th

Benefit(s): You can cast dream travel once per day as a spell-like ability. This dream travel has a range of personal and a target of you, with a caster level equal to your character level.
